purpose: Machine-readable snapshot of current Worldshepherd readiness, evidence maturity, marketplace, contact-gate, next-external-jump and security movement under the claims-controlled framework.

historical_pre_baseline.boundary: Historical PRE score measured ability to execute the next controlled step; it did not override evidence, eligibility or approval gates.

portfolio_internal_partner_readiness.boundary: Internal/partner readiness is preparation readiness and is not physical, partner, field, clinical, flight, certification or independent-validation maturity.

effective_evidence_maturity.source_of_truth_logic: readiness/portfolio.v1.json base states plus approved evidence/closures.v1.json maturity_updates

external_evidence.boundary: A low external-gate closure percentage alongside high internal readiness is expected and desirable under fail-closed evidence separation; it prevents preparation from being mislabeled as validation.

next_external_jump_program.boundary: The validated jump program is preparation only. No workstream is promoted until target-specific externally authorized evidence satisfies the partner-test contract and existing external gate.

marketplace.boundary: Synthetic coverage and route verification do not establish target interest, operational effectiveness, remediation probability, supplier qualification or contact authorization.

boeing_spirit.contact_action: DO NOT CONTACT — EXTERNAL VALIDATION GATES REMAIN OPEN
boeing_spirit.boundary: The 55.0 value is an internal evidence/fit score and is not a statistical probability of fixing Boeing or Spirit.

security_premerge.boundary: The supplemental audit is diagnostic and does not resolve CodeQL alerts. PR #62 remains blocked from merge under the zero-open-medium/high/critical policy; the last completed CodeQL result still reported eight medium alerts.

interpretation.largest_positive_jump: Internal execution/governance and marketplace preparation are near-saturated under the current readiness model, and six workstreams now have validated fail-closed partner-test transition packages.
interpretation.largest_remaining_gap: External evidence maturity: 58 of 63 registered gates remain open and no portfolio workstream has yet reached partner_test or higher effective maturity.
interpretation.current_bottleneck: Partner-authorized data/tests, independent review, measured outcomes, qualification/certification where applicable, and resolution of the PR #62 security gate.
interpretation.next_jump_rule: Further internal documentation alone cannot be counted as partner/field/physical/certification maturity. Each next jump must be bound to the required evidence class.
